name: River Valley
pros: Rich floodplain soil, fresh water close by, river fish.
cons: Spring floods can drown fields and huts.

name: Open Plains
pros: Big herds, easy grazing, wild grain.
cons: Little timber, cold winds, and you can be seen from far away.

name: Deep Forest
pros: Endless timber, nuts and berries, hidden from rivals.
cons: Wolves and bears, and poor ground for fields.

name: Coast
pros: The best fishing there is, and strangers bring new ideas.
cons: Contested: rivals covet the shore and raid twice as hard. Storms.

name: Lakeshore
pros: Calm water, fish, reeds and plenty to drink.

name: Highlands
pros: Double stone and ore, and high ground is easy to defend.
cons: Thin soil and cold nights — your people go hungry.

name: Mountain Pass
pros: Controls the way through: trade, ore and a natural fortress.

name: Jungle Edge
pros: Food everywhere, and medicinal plants grow wild.
cons: Fever takes everyone sooner or later; big cats hunt at night.

name: Marshland
pros: Reeds, fowl and fish; raiders get lost in the fens.
cons: Damp sickness, and soft ground makes building slow.

name: Dry Steppe
pros: Horses and herds, long sight lines, good hunting.
cons: Water is far, timber scarce, droughts common.
